analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. It bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds one row to the timing table near head line 2016, documenting watchdog crash-restart timing (next check after the outage is seen, 1-2 min; 300 s grace when continuing a crash-loop chain). There is no source, config or control change. The supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 805-1720) of the surrounding doc, which cover autopilot, addon hold, stop/restart, status, doctor, models, benchmark, update, fan, login/logout/unenroll and refusal lines. They contain no head-side changed lines. I checked the new row only through the patch excerpt, since the added line is not in the supplied numbered text. Relevant threat IDs are T-043 (watchdog rollback authority) and TB-003; the doc row describes existing behavior and does not alter it. The row's accuracy against WatchdogDecision.swift and WatchdogPolicy.graceSeconds is not verified from the supplied evidence. Documentation drift there could mislead operators about crash-loop recovery timing, but it is not a security regression. The surrounding text references the TB-012 addon hold, fan helper, drain/stop lifecycle and the prefix cache (T-041), all unchanged. No new attack surface, invalidated assumption or threat-model gap was identified.
